bodyHtml:
Expertise

Software ecodesign and performance experts at the service of your project

Audit of an existing or redesigned application, improvement support, Greenspector Certificate: our teams support you end to end.

Contact us to speak directly with our experts or our certified partners.

Getting started

Audit an application

The efficiency, environmental impact and performance audit with Greenspector Studio is an excellent starting point to structure your approach.

Describe the user journey, we take care of the rest: automation, test execution, results analysis and recommendations report.

You then have a concrete action plan to reduce the impacts of your application.

Certificate

The Greenspector Digital Service Efficiency Certificate

The certificate is awarded to mobile applications and websites that combine energy efficiency, data efficiency and performance.

  • Energy efficiency on user device: to reduce quality risks, improve inclusion and reduce impacts.
  • Data consumption efficiency: to reduce environmental footprint and facilitate mobile usage.
  • Performance: to limit footprint while improving UX.

Measurements are grouped, analysed then converted to scores. An ecoscore from 0 to 100 summarises the whole, with three certificate levels: Bronze (50-69), Silver (70-89), Gold (90-100).

A badge displayable on your site or in your application is linked to an authentication page hosted by us.
